effect_description_eng:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, delete 1 of their Digimon with 8000 DP or less.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Activate 1 [On Play] effect on a face-up [Zaxon] trait Digimon card in your security stack as an effect of this Digimon.
